details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It publishes version 99.9.1 of the internal-looking name sc-wizard — an empty module (index.js is `module.exports = {}`) with no lifecycle hooks — whose single dependency is resolved from a non-registry tarball URL, hxxps://ltidi[.]storage[.]googleapis[.]com/depenconf/ltidisafe-4.0.1[.]tgz. Installing the package therefore pulls code from a Google Cloud Storage bucket outside the npm registry, bypassing registry review and integrity tracking. The package itself contains no executable logic and no code that reads environment variables, tokens, credential files, or wallet data.
